steps.lead: From sign-up to your first trade in one afternoon.
steps.s1_d: Sign up in minutes with your email or phone.

steps.s3_d: Deposit by card, bank transfer or e-wallet.
steps.s4_d: Pick a market, set your risk and place your first trade.
faq.label: FAQ
faq.still_d: Our team answers in your language, 24/5.
faq.a1: ABX Global is a regulated online broker offering stocks, ETFs, commodities, forex and indices on one platform.
faq.q2: How do I open an account?
faq.a2: Complete the sign-up form, verify your identity and fund your account. The whole process usually takes less than 10 minutes.
faq.a3: More than 250 instruments: stocks and ETFs, commodities, currency pairs, global indices and selected pre-IPO opportunities.
faq.a4: Yes. Client funds are held in segregated accounts at leading European banks, and eligible clients are covered up to €20,000.
faq.q5: How do deposits and withdrawals work?
faq.a5: Deposit by card, bank transfer or e-wallet. Withdrawals are usually processed within 24 hours, back to the account the deposit came from.
faq.a6: Yes. The ABX app for iOS and Android has the same tools, charts and accounts as the web platform.
